title: 2014 HMMT February Geometry Problem 2
statement: Point \(P\) and line \(\ell\) are such that the distance from \(P\) to \(\ell\) is 12 . Given that \(T\) is a point on \(\ell\) such that \(P T=13\), find the radius of the circle passing through \(P\) and tangent to \(\ell\) at \(T\).

solutions.text: \(169 / 24\) Let \(O\) be the center of the given circle, \(Q\) be the foot of the altitude from \(P\) to \(\ell\), and \(M\) be the midpoint of \(P T\). Then since \(O M \perp P T\) and \(\angle O T P=\angle T P Q, \triangle O M P \sim \triangle T Q P\). Thus the \(O P=T P \cdot \frac{P M}{P Q}=13 \cdot \frac{13 / 2}{12}=\frac{169}{24}\)
